tiktok_import.provider: Direct public TikTok video/photo retrieval + Groq + local Tesseract OCR
tiktok_import.limits: Videos: 180 seconds, 50 MB, 16 sampled OCR frames. Photos: 15 images, 8 MB/image, 50 MB total, 12000 text characters. 2 active / 8 total tasks.
tiktok_import.storage: Up to 32 public-source results in server memory for 24h; user edits remain private; media files temporary
tiktok_import.expiry: No automatic expiry; removal is a later code change
tiktok_import.identifier_handling: Known identifiers; spelling and bounded Yahoo-search suggestions require review
tiktok_import.empty_result_handling: Explicit supported-list recovery; otherwise one additional model check
tiktok_import.recheck: Explicit extraction-only recheck with 30-second cooldown; source transcript/OCR reused for video and photo posts
tiktok_import.creator: Canonical video handle preferred; numeric UIDs hidden
tiktok_import.clear_import: Clears link, result and edits; shared source cache retained
tiktok_import.previous_live_user_test: User reported successful transcription, plus empty extraction and missing identifiers in the prior version
tiktok_import.release_guard: All helpers must match app release; reload once on mismatch
tiktok_import.clean_cloud_build: Requested via requirements.txt change; deployed restart not independently confirmed
tiktok_import.live_root_cause: User v3 report confirms AMC recognized; actual model omitted nearly-6x conditional target. Other earlier empty-result cases remain unconfirmed.
tiktok_import.numeric_target_recovery: Single named asset/one explicit future multiple; no extra API call; rejects valuation/past/teaching examples and ambiguous/conflicting targets
tiktok_import.format_recovery: One JSON Object Mode attempt after HTTP 400 chat error; same model/source; local schema validation; no retries of other HTTP errors
tiktok_import.error_diagnostics: HTTP status and whitelisted provider details, connection key redacted
tiktok_import.latest_live_failure: Stockdads report is request_failed with HTTP-400-mapped message; original provider error details absent, exact cause unconfirmed
tiktok_import.etf_support: ETF is an explicit type across extraction/review/manual/CSV/search. Generic literal ETF-ticker source recovery; no per-video ticker list.
tiktok_import.photo_import: Full /photo/ links; gallery-dl 1.32.20 anonymous metadata and supplied CDN image URLs, English OCR of every image plus caption. Same Groq extraction and review; no background audio or image display.
tiktok_import.photo_share_links: Full /photo/ URLs supported; shortened photo share links not verified.

tracker.storage: Per-browser localStorage on the app origin; no login or cross-device sync. Simple tracker interface without backup/upload/download controls.
tracker.stored_fields: Whitelisted prediction/source facts, target/time frame, optional split/evaluation basis and reviewed archive identifier, saved_at; no media/full transcripts/OCR/reports/keys/prices.
entry_points: Calculated curated examples; Bear Stearns context-only excluded
tracker.duplicate_handling: Same original post + asset updates the existing record; manual identities include ticker/type/date/creator/claim.

tracker.new_predictions: Saving requires no available prices. Today: no market call. Fewer than two common later closes: no return.
tracker.isolation: Browser lists and session data separate from the shared import-result cache. No external storage provider.
tracker.validation: Native Streamlit AppTest with simulated storage/API plus Node frontend contract; actual Chromium launch blocked by socket policy.

comparison_calendar: All available comparison series use identical common observation dates, entry and cutoff. SPY non-trading dates excluded from return/drawdown observations; nominal targets retain full asset history within the evaluated window.
comparison_exports: Both benchmark returns and differences in period and batch CSVs; three-series chart data and per-reference deadline results in JSON.
missing_comparison_handling: Show only available references, with an explicit warning. No fabricated reference series or difference. No result without sufficient common data.

context_case: Bear Stearns: six sourced reported closing prices around the statement; no stock-price forecast or equity trade inferred.
split_review: ARK 2021 Tesla target USD 3000 converted manually to USD 1000 after verified 2022-08-25 3:1 split. Evaluation requires exact observed/reviewed event match. New or unreviewed events remain blocked.
